Develop and maintain AI messaging and positioning that flexes across audiences (field, analysts, press, customers) - Drive field enablement for AI, arming Sales and CS with the story, objection handling, and proof points they need - Plan and execute AI product launches, from planning through post-launch measurement - Represent the AI narrative in customer-facing and market-facing moments (analyst briefings, customer advisory conversations, press as needed) How to be successful in this role: - Core PMM experience - 7+ years in product marketing, ideally with ownership of a full pillar or product line rather than a support function - Track record of building narrative and positioning from scratch, not just executing an existing playbook - Experience partnering directly with Product/Engineering leadership - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Plan and execute large product launches (including partnership with comms to align on product narrative), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale - Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s security products, including messaging, positioning, launch planning, GTM enablement content (sales, customer success), and customer adoption - Strong written and verbal storytelling, comfortable writing for a keynote stage as well as a sales deck - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship Technical / AI fluency - Working understanding of how modern AI products are built, enough to ask sharp questions in an EPD roadmap review and push back credibly - Familiarity with the current AI/LLM landscape (model capabilities, common architecture patterns, where the industry conversation is headed) so positioning reflects real technical nuance rat

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:5e.title: Estimator - Construction
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:5e.description: The Estimator is accountable for the accuracy, completeness, defensibility, and profitability of all commercial plumbing estimates produced by the organization. This role functions as a core revenue-generation and margin-protection position, responsible for converting qualified bid opportunities into disciplined, competitive, and executable proposals.
responsibilities: 1. Bid Pipeline Development & Governance
The Estimator is accountable for managing a controlled and intentional bid pipeline sourced exclusively from two approved channels and governed by formal bid controls.
This includes accountability for:
Developing estimates from inbound bid invitations received directly from General Contractors (GCs)
Managing negotiated and relationship-based bid opportunities
Proactively identifying bid opportunities through approved sourcing platforms (e.g., PlanHub, AGC sites, public bid portals)
Screening all opportunities using documented bid/no-bid criteria
Enforcing capacity, backlog, and risk constraints prior to pursuit
Managing bid calendars, deadlines, addenda, and final submission timing
Coordinating pursuit strategy and prioritization with the VP of Sales & Marketing
2. Estimating & Bid Development
The Estimator is accountable for producing complete, defensible, and market-aligned estimates.
Performing detailed quantity takeoffs for all commercial plumbing systems
Developing labor projections using standardized productivity assumptions
Pricing materials, fixtures, equipment, and subcontracted work using current supplier data
Accounting for escalation, phasing, access constraints, and schedule impacts
Identifying and documenting scope gaps, exclusions, clarifications, and assumptions
Preparing bid proposals, scope letters, and qualifications in approved formats
3. Pricing, Margin & Market Risk Management
The Estimator is accountable for protecting margin in dynamic market conditions.
Maintaining current price books, supplier data, and labor modifiers
Incorporating material volatility, labor availability, and escalation risk into estimates
Validating estimates against historical job cost and profitability data
Applying approved overhead, labor burden, and profit targets
Escalating abnormal market conditions to Sales leadership
4. Sales Alignment & Pre-Bid Support
The Estimator is accountable for collaborating in a disciplined manner with Sales leadership and external stakeholders.
Participating in bid/no-bid and pricing strategy discussions
Responding to GC inquiries, addenda, and clarification requests
Supporting value engineering efforts without compromising margin or scope
Ensuring all pre-award commitments are documented and approved
5. Project Handoff to Operations
The Estimator is accountable for a formal, standardized transition of awarded projects.
This includes accountability for delivering a complete handoff package consisting of:
Final estimate summary
Labor budgets and productivity assumptions
Material pricing assumptions and supplier commitments
Exclusions, clarifications, and scope qualifications
Documented risk items and constraints
qualifications: Experience
Minimum 8 years of commercial Plumbing or HVAC experience, including estimating
Demonstrated success in estimating complex commercial construction projects
Knowledge
Commercial Plumbing systems, HVAC systems, and construction means and methods
Job costing, labor productivity, and market pricing dynamics
Competitive, negotiated, and alternative delivery bid environments
Skills
High analytical rigor and attention to detail
Independent judgment under deadline pressure
Clear written and verbal communication
Ability to enforce discipline without positional authority

jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:3b64145a.title: HQ - Senior Application Security Engineer (Remote)
jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:3b64145a.description: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Application Security Engineer to help build secure products at scale. As a trusted partner to Engineering and Product teams, you will drive security by design across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), leading initiatives such as threat modelling, secure code reviews, security automation, and developer enablement. You will play a key role in shaping our Application Security strategy, helping us build secure, resilient products while enabling engineering teams to move fast with confidence. This is a fully remote position with flexibility within ±1 hour of CET.
responsibilities: Act as the Application Security Subject Matter Expert (SME), partnering with Engineering and Product teams to embed security throughout the SDLC.
Lead application security reviews, threat modelling, code reviews and penetration testing to identify and mitigate security risks.
Design, implement and automate security controls across CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, SCA and other AppSec tooling.
Drive the technical roadmap of the Application Security program, improving secure development practices and scaling security initiatives across the organisation.
Improve and manage application security controls, including WAF, Kubernetes security and vulnerability management.
Mentor Security Champions and junior engineers, promoting a strong security culture across development teams.
Define and communicate meaningful Application Security metrics to measure risk reduction and program effectiveness.

lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:b28053f9-2.description: ABOUT LIGHTFIELD Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. The market agrees. Over 5,000 companies have used Lightfield since we launched in November, making us the fastest-adopted product in our category. ABOUT THE ROLE Lightfield is reinventing CRM from the ground up - and we're doing it fast. We're an early-stage startup where every hire directly shapes our trajectory, and we're looking for a hands-on technical recruiter to help us build the next phase of our engineering team. You'll work closely with our technical leaders to source exceptional candidates, run initial screens, manage processes end-to-end, and help us close great people. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who loves recruiting, moves quickly, has strong judgment on technical talent, and wants significant ownership at an early-stage company. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Full-cycle technical recruiting - end-to-end ownership across our technical roles, with a focus on scaling our Engineering team. Senior engineers, ML specialists, infrastructure leads - you know how to find them, pitch them, and close them in competitive markets. - Sourcing engine, zero → one - proactively build strong technical candidate pipelines rather than relying on inbound.
